localBiteReport: Reports from the week of November 17–18, 2026 show redfish continuing to be the most reliable inshore target in Choctawhatchee Bay, with at least two good-sized fish caught under the bridge on a recent charter out of Destin. A Freeport-based guide reported an active bite around the same period, noting overall catch rates have been decent but quality fish a bit harder to come by. Guides also note that Florida's flounder season closed at the end of October, so that target is off the table for now; sheepshead, however, are beginning to show up around bridge pilings and structure and numbers should build as November deepens into cooler water. Water temperature at this location is 70°F. Note: Half Hitch (halfhitch.com) has published Destin fishing reports dated November 9 and November 16, 2026, but the content of those posts could not be loaded — check those directly for the most granular local bay breakdown.
